rationale: I re-hashed (0b05e21b...) and read the held EO 8619 text (5 FR 5256, signed 1940-12-23; Designating the Director of Selective Service to Perform Certain Functions and Duties Under the Selective Training and Service Act of 1940). Its sole paragraph designates the Director to perform all presidential functions under the Act relating to appeals from boards of appeal and says the Selective Service Regulations on such appeals are modified accordingly. It is a continuing designation, not a one-time command, and states no duration or condition. The sole API observation has empty text and the cruden search found no held later instrument naming it, so there is no ACT/TERM/ACTOR_TEXT record. An ending might follow from expiry of the underlying Act, but an endpoint needs a reason shown by held evidence (owner ruling 2026-10-28), and the Act's expiry is not held. No YES predicate exists. I leave the recommendation blank and name the statutory source needed.
